votes.motion: Approve the drilling and installation of a geothermic well at 32 West Acres Road, provided a deed restriction notes the well is not a source of potable water and a well drilling permit is obtained from Nashoba Associated Board of Health.
votes.quote: on motion by rabbit and second by jewell, the board voted unanimously to approve the drilling and installation of a geothermic well

votes.motion: Approve Steve Marsden's request for the 91 Maple Parkway septic replacement: offset to groundwater 4 feet to 3 feet, sieve analysis in lieu of percolation test, and offset to wetlands 100 feet to 53 feet.
votes.quote: on motion by jewell and second by rabbit, the board voted unanimously to approve the request.

votes.motion: Approve Bob Proctor's request regarding the 43 Hemlock Terrace septic tank and water line offsets.
votes.quote: on motion by jewell and second by rabbitt, the request was unanimously approved.
